blogAuthor.name: Alex Furukawa
blogAuthor.bio: Alex Furukawa is the founder of Iro AI, the gamified app for learning to use AI well. He works in private equity real estate, where he leads his firm's AI initiative and builds the automation his team runs on live deals. He writes about practical AI fluency: prompting, AI tools, and the daily habits that turn AI from a novelty into hours you get back.

cta.heading: Practice this, don't just read it.
cta.body: Iro AI turns ideas like the ones in this post into 5-minute exercises with feedback. Free tier, Pro from $4.17 a month ($49.99 a year, 7-day free trial).
